title: Real part of the cubic product
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $x=(x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1})\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and write $m_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ for each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The real part of the product satisfies
\[\operatorname{Re}\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\left(-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}x_i\,i\right)=\left(-\frac12\right)^n\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\\ |S|\text{ even}}}(-1)^{\lfloor (|S|\bmod 4)/2\rfloor}(\sqrt3)^{|S|}m_S(x),\]
where $i=\sqrt{-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an $n$-tuple with each coordinate in $\{−1,1\}$
